summary: Turns product photos into SEO-ready marketplace listings for Etsy, eBay and more. A genuine free plan, monthly plans, or pay-as-you-go credit packs.
description: Turns product photos into SEO-ready marketplace listings for Etsy, eBay and more. A genuine free plan, monthly plans, or pay-as-you-go credit packs.

pricing.details: Free (100 listing credits refill each month; this is a real free plan, not a trial). Starter 16 €/month; Standard 54 €/month; Premium 161 €/month. Pay-as-you-go packs (never expire): 1,000 credits 27 €; 2,000 45 €; 5,000 89 €. New-customer first-purchase offer also shown: 500 credits for 5 € (not the standing pack ladder).
pricing.label: Freemium
